theory.intro: To place an irrational number on a number line, replace it with a decimal approximation and mark that position. For example, $\sqrt{2}\approx1.41$ sits a little less than halfway between $1$ and $2$.
facts: Approximate the irrational number as a decimal, usually to $2$ decimal places, e.g. $\sqrt{3}\approx1.73$.
steps: Approximate the irrational number as a decimal, to $2$ decimal places.
Find the two integers it lies between.
Mark the point that fraction of the way along the interval.
